scenarios.subject: Following Up from the SEO Career Summit
scenarios.body:
Hi Olivia,

Thank you for the conversation at the SEO Career Summit in New York. I enjoyed hearing more about Morrow & Pike's recruiting process.

My name is Maya Okafor, and I am a sophomore at Duke University studying Economics, graduating in May 2029. It was great to meet a fellow Duke alum recruiting for the firm, and I was glad to find we're both from Atlanta.

This past summer I interned at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, where I built a screening model for dividend stocks used in client portfolio reviews. I currently work as a consumer sector analyst for the Duke Investment Club, and between those experiences I've become especially drawn to consumer and retail M&A.

I had two questions, if you have a moment. First, when does the sophomore program open for the upcoming cycle? Second, does that program feed directly into the summer analyst class, or is it a separate process?

I've attached my resume here for you to look over. Thank you very much for your time!

Best,
Maya Okafor
Duke University ’29
maya.okafor@duke.edu
(919) 555-0142
